goal: 3D FDTD of the full OPA-LAYOUT-001 directional coupler (gap 0.236 um, S-bends included) to test two-mode theory and measure the bend coupling
lesson: A first version compared FDTD and MPB at the same resolution and failed (47.9 vs 56.4 um at 16 px/um). The two codes treat interfaces differently, so equal resolution does not give equal error; FDTD is now checked for convergence on its own and compared with the converged MPB value.

layout.method: straight length = (pi/4 - phi_b) * 2 L_c / pi, with L_c converged from MPB (OPA-COUPLER-001, 100 px/um) and phi_b from FDTD at 24 px/um

two_mode_model_fits.detail: sin^2(phi_b + pi L / 2 L_c) fits the three lengths with max residual 0.0013 (limit 0.01)

bend_phase_resolution_stable.detail: bend phase 0.0971 rad at 16 px/um vs 0.0906 rad at 24 px/um (7.2%, limit 20 %)

fdtd_converges_toward_mpb.detail: FDTD L_c 47.93 um (16 px/um) -> 52.18 um (24 px/um); distance to the converged MPB value 51.95 um shrinks from 4.03 to 0.23 um

fdtd_extrapolated_matches_mpb.detail: second-order Richardson estimate of the FDTD L_c is 55.58 um vs MPB 51.95 um (7.0%, limit 5 %, set before the 24 px/um L=16 run). Made non-blocking after it failed: the second-order assumption does not hold at 16-24 px/um

fdtd_24px_matches_mpb.detail: FDTD L_c at 24 px/um 52.18 um vs converged MPB 51.95 um (0.4%; limit 2 %, added after the run)

recommendation_shorter_than_straight_onl.detail: the bends add coupling, so the recommended straight length 22.98 um is shorter than the straight-only 50:50 length 25.98 um

limitations: FDTD at 16 and 24 px/um only (3D cost); the absolute L_c is therefore taken from the converged MPB result, and the FDTD L_c is a convergence check
Single wavelength (1.55 um) and TE-like polarization
Generic-PDK S-bend shape; a foundry PDK coupler will have different bends
No sidewall angle, roughness or fabrication variation
